selection_rationale: Reviewer verdict = pass, highest immediate feasibility and venue relevance; directly targets an important unresolved gap (empirical evaluation of generate→verify→repair with deterministic validators) and offers a clear, falsifiable paired design with moderate model-call cost and reproducibility potential.
unresolved_uncertainties: Deterministic validator false negatives: validators may miss semantic/policy errors leading to undetected actionable failures.
Actionable-error ground truth: need for a precisely specified annotation protocol and inter-annotator reliability for semantic vs policy labels.
Single-repair sufficiency: whether one automated repair attempt adequately characterizes repair dynamics or underestimates iterative repair utility.
Synthetic-to-production generalization: vendor/protocol idiosyncrasies in synthetic vendor families may limit external validity.
Validator–LLM interaction risk: LLMs could overfit to validator messages producing superficially valid but semantically incorrect configs.
required_repairs_before_preregistration: Publish a precise actionable-error annotation protocol (definitions, labeling instructions) and run an inter-annotator agreement check on a labeled subset.

Extend validator specification: enumerate deterministic checks, known coverage gaps, and record validator uncertainty; add fallback semantic checks (simulator-based policy tests) where deterministic checks are insufficient.
Clarify stopping-rule for repair attempts: justify single-repair hypothesis or add a small multi-repair ablation (e.g., up to 3 automated repairs) to measure diminishing returns.
